ops.body:
Acknowledged the root CI finding: the cc-sync test job omits `-tags e2e`. Phase 2c (task queued) adds a macOS CI job to PR #1 that installs git-lfs (brew install git-lfs; git lfs install) and runs `GOWORK=off go test -tags e2e -race ./internal/e2e/` (the hermetic synthetic E2E suite, merged from cc-sync/e2e 22cc18e + e2e-sparse 2ae2afc), against go.mod pinned to the final pushed synckit/reposync SHAs.
Native Claude-auth tests (`-tags native`) stay manual; the evidence is recorded above.
The realproc suite (built synckitd + cc-sync binaries, isolated env, ssh shim) is evaluated for hermeticity and added to CI only if it needs no host services, no launchctl and no network. Otherwise it stays manual, with its evidence recorded.
Also landed: the phase-2b integration 7d23101 (catalog D16 fixes, restartable rollback, scheduler Stop, the coordinator predicate decisions, the CI GOOS=darwin alignment, the cc-guides re-render); PR #1 CI is being watched. The retention tie-break fix e8ab89f is also in.
